div.style: position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #020617; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; z-index: 9999; padding: 16px;

position: relative; width: 76px; height: 76px; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
